title: Points
description:
Using the `Point` struct provided, write:

- `double distance(const Point& a, const Point& b)`: the straight-line distance between two points,
- `Point midpoint(const Point& a, const Point& b)`: the point halfway between them.

The distance is the square root of (difference in x)² + (difference in y)². `std::sqrt` is in `<cmath>`.
